Persistent recovery accompanied by stronger ETH/BTC, improving bucket medians and continuing positive settled flows would replace it with a clearer UP outlook.
missing_evidence: Additional settled ETF sessions to establish whether the latest inflows represent persistence or a single-session interruption.

Evidence that liquidity is being deployed into ETH and broader alts rather than remaining available supply.
supporting_evidence: Weak hourly prices, seller-led spot flow and only 20% advancing participation keep renewed weakness credible.
Positive final BTC and ETH ETF flows provide a genuine counterweight to current selling, but only one session is supplied.
